# pd4d10/json-viewer vendor notice

This directory vendors the production `content-script.js` bundle from
[pd4d10/json-viewer](https://github.com/pd4d10/json-viewer) version **2.2.0**
(Chrome Web Store package `efknglbfhoddmmfabeihlemgekhhnabb`, built 2024-03-27).

That project is a port of Firefox's JSON Viewer for Chromium. The bundled
renderer therefore includes:

- MIT-licensed wrapper code by Rongjian Zhang (pd4d10) — see `LICENSE`
- Mozilla DevTools JSON Viewer UI (Mozilla Public License 2.0)
- React and related runtime libraries (MIT) — see `content-script.js.LICENSE.txt`

Source: https://github.com/pd4d10/json-viewer
Firefox JSON Viewer docs: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Tools/JSON_viewer
